The '''D/Square Decoder''' was a decryption and deciphering system used in military and police databanks, as well as [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]] bases. It was designed and manufactured by [[Fedukowski]].
